question: How do I vote absentee or by mail?

nuggets.text: Mail-in voting is part of each election the Board runs.
nuggets.quote: Election observers shall be allowed uniform and nondiscriminatory access to all stages of the election process, including the certification of election technologies, early and mail-in voting, and vote tabulation.

nuggets.text: The Board of Elections administers it.
nuggets.quote: (2) The Board shall permit any duly registered voter to vote by mail-in ballot, for any reason, under such rules as the Board may issue.

nuggets.text: Registration must be in by the 21st day before the election to vote in it.
nuggets.quote: A registration or request to activate the elector's registration that is received no later than 4:45 P.M. on the 21st day preceding any election, or such time on that day as the Board’s office remains open to receive registrations, shall be accepted.
